request.prompt:
Deliverable: landscape flat data infographic for a Chinese AI engineering article.
Primary request: explain an original Jev rerank evaluation with one clear conclusion: English quality is roughly tied with a dedicated reranker, Chinese quality is lower, but Jev is much faster; call shape also affects quality.
Composition: warm paper background, large title at top, three horizontal dataset rows. Row 1: "SciFact" with "EN", "quality: tie", and "8.9× faster". Row 2: "NFCorpus" with "EN", "quality: tie", and "7.5–8.2× faster". Row 3: "T2Retrieval" with "ZH", "quality: Jev lower", and "9.5× faster". Use a small split comparison icon for each row and a speed arrow. Add a bottom banner: "调用形状决定质量" and a small subline: "一次问完 50 篇 ≠ 一篇一问".
Style and medium: flat editorial benchmark infographic, similar to a high-quality Chinese technical note: warm off-white paper, dark ink typography, coral and teal accents, clean comparison rows, hand-drawn but precise, no 3D, no photorealism.
Text (exact): The only readable text allowed is "Jev 做 Rerank：英文打平，中文落后", "SciFact", "EN", "quality: tie", "8.9× faster", "NFCorpus", "7.5–8.2× faster", "T2Retrieval", "ZH", "quality: Jev lower", "9.5× faster", "调用形状决定质量", and "一次问完 50 篇 ≠ 一篇一问". Render each exactly once. Do not invent scores, percentages, citations, or extra labels.
Avoid: false precision, fake charts, invented benchmark names, duplicated text, misspellings, watermark.
